newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Soymeal in Europe follow Chicago sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: Soymeal in Europe follow Chicago sharply lower.

text.p: Sellers on the European meals and feeds market offered nearby soymeal pellets as much as $9 lower following last night's sharply lower Chicago soymeal futures close, but met little buying interest, dealers said.
Most other products were offered unchanged to a few dollars lower.
"There is still little faith in the market and buyers picked up a bit of last half 1997 sunmeal as that product is relatively cheap," one broker said.
July/Sept Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $120 a tonne cif Rotterdam and Oct/Dec at $126.50 cif.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
